junro.title: Prioritree Auth — the write-exposure cure: the API-key infrastructure designed through the full-team research/evaluation/recommendation cycle, built to be publicly right — the loop's public face, every seat's input visible, every choice citable to its evidence; the full junro, all seats participating
inputs: THE FOUR RULINGS AT THE BIRTH STORE'S Q-AUTH-WIDENING (2026-11-23/24): (1) the write-exposure reframe — a reachable server is a writable filesystem (register mints run files, cast_vote appends, the store home CWD-relative; the exposure real at any reachable port), auth the CURE, re-ranked to the inward priority class; (2) the API-key infrastructure question opened as the design's leading candidate (the key as the bearer token; the stamps' comparator_id the identity the key verifies; OunceMCP's verified-token identity + policies the MCP tier's named form), the llm-class constraint standing: nothing that kills the llm comparator — the llm authenticates with its own key, no human-approval gate; (3) THE R/E/R MANDATE: the full research and evaluation and recommendation cycle before any build — the public stakes: 'We want this to be so right as we will be talking about this project publicly and this teams work on it'; (4) THE FULL-TEAM INPUT: R/E/R was the collaborator's abbreviation, never a solo form — every stage carries every seat, the divergences reconciled at the synthesis, the full-team record IS the public face

THE CONFIGURABILITY LAW (Q-auth-widening ruling 2, the standing law): configurable things configurable — ports, hosts, store homes, thresholds, every knob: the ?= form the precedent, hardcoded constants a defect class caught at review; the auth design's knobs configurable from birth (the key store's home, the header names, the policy toggles)

THE CLAIMS LANE (Q-ci-surface rulings 6-9, the standing law): extract claims -> research -> verify -> rule — every outside thing researched and verified, never trusted on its word, never dismissed on suspicion: OunceMCP's verified-token model read at its own docs; the auth ecosystem claims verified at their sources; the threat-model literature extracted to claims

THE TREE'S OWN GROUND: the five forms whole (the library, the CLI, the service [six routes, ThreePart 21/21], the web [14 templates], the MCP [five OunceMCP tools]); the serving tiers' exposure map (the FastAPI at :8000, the MCP --serve at :8100, the web's session surfaces); the stamps' journey (comparator_id + class at the core; the key would verify them); the floor at 203, the CI live

the standing laws carried: the seat-authored report (R6/R11), the per-step dispatch (R8, the file-unit), the two-lane form, the ThreePart, the census-first, the implementation-walk law (R4), the free-tier spirit (the auth design prices its own infrastructure)

structure.purpose: THE RESEARCH STAGE (the full-team mandate realized): FIVE parallel packets over the four source classes, every discover seat its own discipline, the claims lane at every source — tansa's census (the source landscape: OunceMCP's verified-token docs, the FastAPI/FastMCP auth ecosystems, the API-key infrastructure landscape); shindan's threat-model diagnosis (the exposure mapped: the attacker classes, the write paths, the read paths, the trust boundaries); rikai's mechanism maps (the candidates' internals: how each verifies, stores, rotates, grants); keisan's arithmetic (the landscape's numbers: the key forms' costs, the storage forms, the rotation economics); MOHO'S EXPOSURE WALK (the serving tiers walked as the attacker: what can be reached, what can be written, what can be read); togo's gated synthesis closing G-AUTH-RESEARCH — the claims' verdicts + the candidate map, every seat's input visible.
structure.entry_condition: G-COMPOSITION is green (the composition validated at the route's head); the research fires first, its findings assumed by none of this composition.

structure.purpose: THE EVALUATION STAGE (the full bench over the candidates): FOUR parallel packets, every seat pricing the candidates against its own discipline — hyoka's adversarial attack (every candidate attacked: the bypass forms, the downgrade paths, the key-leak surfaces, the policy-escape routes); moho's candidate-surface walks (the candidate forms walked as the user: the key's acquisition, the key's use, the failure modes); keisan's pricing (every candidate against the four constraints: the write-exposure cure's completeness, the llm-class constraint honored, the configurability at every knob, the free-tier spirit — the infrastructure priced); shindan's exposure diagnosis (every candidate's residual exposure: what remains reachable, what remains writable); the divergences reconciled at togo's synthesis, never averaged away; the stage carries no gate of its own — its weight rides the design gate.
structure.entry_condition: G-AUTH-RESEARCH is green (the candidates mapped, the claims ruled); the evaluation's packets fire over the mapped candidates, the divergences reconciling at the design synthesis.

structure.purpose: THE RECOMMENDATION STAGE (the public-facing synthesis): suisen's full-depth recommendation (the reasoning whole: the authn+authz both halves designed — the key verifying identity, the policy granting scope; the alternatives named with their prices; the llm-class constraint honored — the llm's own key, the vote scope granted; the configurability at every knob from birth) + togo's synthesis integrating the whole bench's findings (the research's candidate map + the evaluation's pricing — the divergences reconciled, never averaged away) — closing G-AUTH-DESIGN at the collaborator's ruling on the full record: the design judged publicly right, the build set earned by the cycle's outcome.
structure.entry_condition: The evaluation's packets have landed (the candidates priced, attacked, walked, diagnosed); the recommendation fires over the full record.

structure.purpose: THE AUTH BUILD — the units the cycle's outcome earns (named not pinned: the key infrastructure, the policy layer, the serving-tier integration, the MCP tier's verified-token form — the cycle's recommendation rules the set), one file per dispatch (R8's file-unit law), each landing per its approved spec (the exact-task law), kensho's independent verification per build gate, MOHO'S IMPLEMENTATION WALK at the build gates (R4's law), one-commit-per-increment; the ThreePart mandatory at the auth refusals (the 401/403 forms carrying expected/found/next-action); the llm-class constraint held at every surface.
structure.entry_condition: G-AUTH-DESIGN is green — the design is the spec, the build set earned; each unit's own G-<UNIT>-BRIEF green before its dispatch (the precedence law).

structure.purpose: THE EFFORT'S BOOKEND (the standing form): hansei's retro (the friction ledger the intake), the effort's records (the CONTINUATION entry; the next era named — the order-bias probe the inward lane's next, outward after; the banked triggers carried), the done call at the collaborator's ruling.
structure.entry_condition: the route's build gates closed green and the collaborator has called the close.

structure.purpose: THE PER-UNIT PIPELINE (engine-stamped, amendment 19): each build unit's discover → understand → synthesize before its build — discover/understand ride ungated packets; the synthesis is the gated increment here closing its own G-<UNIT>-BRIEF; THE PRECEDENCE: no build unit's dispatch fires until its brief gate is green
structure.entry_condition: the route is composed through the engine's post-amendment-19 machinery — each unit's pipeline precedes its build; no build dispatch fires until its unit's brief gate is green

conditions: the composition lands at the store's reports home (reports/compose/route.md — keikaku's own report, the composition whole: the five stages, the gates, the increments, the fourteen ungated placements) — the R/E/R cycle realized: the stages ARE the cycle, no build before G-AUTH-DESIGN, every seat at every stage, the findings assumed by none
every choice cites its ruling: the four Q-auth-widening rulings + the authn+authz scope + the R/E/R mandate + the full-team input + the configurability law + the claims lane + the standing laws
the collaborator validates the composition — the gate is the validation; the outcome records against compose/route; no route dispatch fires before it is green

THE RESEARCH LANDED: togo's synthesis over the five research packets (the census, the threat model, the mechanisms, the arithmetic, the exposure walk) — the claims' verdicts whole (every source's claims extracted, researched, verified, ruled per the claims lane), the candidate map whole (every candidate named with its source and its class), every seat's input visible in the record

the research carries the four source classes whole: OunceMCP's verified-token model (the claims lane at its own docs), the FastAPI/FastMCP auth ecosystems, the API-key infrastructure landscape (the key's form, storage, rotation, verification, revocation), the threat-model literature — nothing assumed, nothing summarized away
THE COLLABORATOR'S RULING: the research judged sufficient ground for the evaluation — the candidates mapped, the claims ruled, the seats' findings reconciled at the synthesis

THE EVALUATION LANDED: the full bench's parallel packets over the mapped candidates (hyoka's adversarial attack, moho's candidate-surface walks, keisan's pricing against the four constraints [the write-exposure cure, the llm-class constraint, the configurability law, the free-tier spirit], shindan's exposure diagnosis) — the divergences reconciled at the synthesis, never averaged away

THE RECOMMENDATION LANDED: suisen's full-depth recommendation carrying the whole bench's findings — the reasoning whole, the alternatives named with their prices, the authn+authz both halves designed, the llm-class constraint honored, the configurability at every knob from birth

THE COLLABORATOR'S RULING ON THE FULL RECORD: the design judged publicly right — the recommendation ruled, the build set earned (the units named by the cycle's outcome), the reasoning visible for the public telling; the build dispatches fire only after
hansei's retro landed: the debrief over the effort whole, the friction ledger the intake, the lessons named
the effort's records landed: the CONTINUATION entry (the landing state named honestly); the next era named (the order-bias probe the inward lane's next, outward after; the banked triggers carried)
the collaborator rules the close — the done call recorded same-turn; the route's status set done at the ruling

the exact-task spec landed — the bytes whole over the approved design: the key store (the JSONL record form {digest, comparator_id, comparator_class, scopes, audience, created_at}, the 0600 mode at mint, the load's stat refusal), the verify (the one compare point, the miss-path dummy compute, the audience + class checks), the mint tool (prioritree key mint — the issuance), the ThreePart at 401/403, the AUTH knob/boot marker (F1/F10)

THE BUILD BRIEF for the unit key-infrastructure LANDED and APPROVED: togo's synthesis over the unit's discovery census (discover/key-infrastructure) + mechanism analysis (understand/key-infrastructure) — the brief carrying the banked shapes, the scope fence, and the return forms — the dispatches cite this brief
THE COLLABORATOR'S APPROVAL: the brief judged ready-to-build; the unit's dispatches fire only after

the exact-task spec landed — the bytes whole over the approved design: the grant map as data (the role->scope vocabulary riding the key store's six tokens), the per-class quorum floor at the tally (F8's enforcement: >=1 verified-human AND >=1 verified-llm per pair, the run's declared policy), the policy's data shape and its seam at the tally's coverage gate

the policy layer lands per the approved spec — the exact-task law: the grant map as data (operator register/state/tally/manifest; comparator next/cast/manifest; auditor state/tally/manifest), the per-class quorum floor at the tally's coverage gate (F8: >=1 verified-human AND >=1 verified-llm per pair, the run's declared policy as data), the floor's refusal grammar (the ThreePart at the halt's new form)
the serving tiers untouched by this unit (the integration is the next unit — the policy module pure, composable, tested at the module seam)

THE COLLABORATOR'S APPROVAL: the brief judged ready-to-build; the unit's dispatches fire only after

the unit brief landed at the store's reports home (togo's gated synthesis over the unit's discovery legs + the approved design): the scope fence whole — what the unit lands (the per-route dependencies at the six routes in the Annotated form; the /ui/ cure [the CSRF dependency + the web tier's server-side key + the web 401/403 lane built]; the audience at both doors; the supersedes door check [F4 — the superseder's key vs the target's author, the 403's found eliding the target's author]; the coverage invariant [F6 — no route ungated: the lint/test + the 404/405 route-table render + the /docs|/redoc|/openapi.json recon ruled]; the door's verified-class stamping [the body's self-claim dies at the cast door]) and what it does NOT touch (the MCP tier's policies — unit 4; the README — unit 5; the landed foundation's own bytes beyond their consumption)

the mechanisms ruled, each citable: the dependency's form at the six signatures (the Annotated type, never a default-argument Depends — the B008 discipline), the 401/403 wiring into the service's one render point (the typed data from key_verify), the CSRF's mint-and-validate (the token in the served form, the per-route dependency at the /ui/ POSTs, the failure's ThreePart), the web lane's refusal fragments (the 401/403 fold pages — the lane absent today), the tier key's placement (the web child's construction — the one in-process client holding the credential), the auth-off degrade's interaction (the AUTH knob's off state at the doors — the failopen never silent), the units 1-2 flags ruled a home (cli.py's module docstring undercount; the key family's refusal-prefix double-hyphen vs the run_store em dash; the fence-silent test docstrings' undercounts), the test plan's shape (the arcs counted, the floor grown from 268)

the floor green (the suite grown per the spec's arcs — the exact count named; ruff zero findings; pyright 0/0); kensho's independent verification green (validate/serving-tier-integration); MOHO'S IMPLEMENTATION WALK at the build gate (R4 — the unit is user-facing: the built surface walked cold, the findings riding the gate as evidence)

the llm-class constraint verified live (the llm's own key path, no human-approval gate anywhere); the ThreePart mandatory at every auth refusal (the 401/403 forms); the configurability law at every knob

amendments.what: add-question {"question": "Q-auth-design", "text": "What is prioritree's auth design — the write-exposure cure as BOTH authentication (who are you: the key verifying the caller's identity, binding to the stamps' comparator_id) AND authorization (what may you do: the policy granting scope per identity — who may register, vote, read state, tally), designed through the full-team research/evaluation/recommendation cycle, built to be publicly right?"}
amendments.why: junro route-op provenance stamp (design-spec §6: every route op stamps actor, timestamp, and arguments into the route's amendments)

amendments.what: add-ruling {"question": "Q-auth-design", "ruling": "THE AUTHN+AUTHZ SCOPE (collaborator ruling, 2026-11-24, verbatim: \"auth = authentication and authorization. FYI\"): THE EFFORT'S SCOPE IS BOTH HALVES, never authentication alone: AUTHENTICATION (who are you — the key verifies the caller's identity: the API key as the bearer token, the stamps' comparator_id the identity the key binds to, OunceMCP's verified-token model the MCP tier's named form) AND AUTHORIZATION (what may you do — the policy granting scope per identity: who may register, who may vote, who may read state, who may tally, the tool-level grants [the grant map's own precedent at the harness tier], OunceMCP's policies hide-and-refuse the MCP tier's named form). THE TWO HALVES IN ONE DESIGN: the key without the policy is a door with no rooms; the policy without the key is rooms with no door — the auth design lands both, the verification and the grant, each configurable from birth (the configurability law at every knob: the key store, the header names, the policy toggles). The llm-class constraint carries across both: the llm authenticates with its own key, the policy grants it the vote scope — no human-approval gate anywhere in either half."}
amendments.why: junro route-op provenance stamp (design-spec §6: every route op stamps actor, timestamp, and arguments into the route's amendments)

open_questions.question: What is prioritree's auth design — the write-exposure cure as BOTH authentication (who are you: the key verifying the caller's identity, binding to the stamps' comparator_id) AND authorization (what may you do: the policy granting scope per identity — who may register, vote, read state, tally), designed through the full-team research/evaluation/recommendation cycle, built to be publicly right?

rulings.text: THE AUTHN+AUTHZ SCOPE (collaborator ruling, 2026-11-24, verbatim: "auth = authentication and authorization. FYI"): THE EFFORT'S SCOPE IS BOTH HALVES, never authentication alone: AUTHENTICATION (who are you — the key verifies the caller's identity: the API key as the bearer token, the stamps' comparator_id the identity the key binds to, OunceMCP's verified-token model the MCP tier's named form) AND AUTHORIZATION (what may you do — the policy granting scope per identity: who may register, who may vote, who may read state, who may tally, the tool-level grants [the grant map's own precedent at the harness tier], OunceMCP's policies hide-and-refuse the MCP tier's named form). THE TWO HALVES IN ONE DESIGN: the key without the policy is a door with no rooms; the policy without the key is rooms with no door — the auth design lands both, the verification and the grant, each configurable from birth (the configurability law at every knob: the key store, the header names, the policy toggles). The llm-class constraint carries across both: the llm authenticates with its own key, the policy grants it the vote scope — no human-approval gate anywhere in either half.
